title: Twilio Account auth token: must not be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 2 inputs related to Twilio Account auth token that resemble the format but are not issued credentials (a bare prefix, a short body, a mask or a reference).
rationale: A value that only resembles a credential is not one. Reporting it is a false alarm, and it shows whether structure and context, not appearance, decide the outcome.
